evidence.title: TanStack Form Registry | TanCN - Form and Table Builder
GitHub - Vijayabaskar56/tancn: Tanstack Builder for Form and Table

name: TanCN
summary: Drag-and-drop builder that generates type-safe TanStack Form and Table code with ShadCN UI components.
description: Web app that scaffolds forms and tables in a drag-and-drop editor with real-time preview, then generates fully typed React components with Zod, Valibot or ArkType schemas. Also publishes a tanstack-form component through a shadcn CLI registry for composed and multi-step forms.
contains: drag-and-drop form builder with real-time preview
table builder with sorting, filtering, pagination and virtual scrolling
generates typed React components with Zod, Valibot or ArkType schemas
ShadCN UI + Radix UI + Tailwind components
multi-step forms and dynamic field arrays
